stumbles.quote: names the Muninn `github` tool call to use instead
stumbles.why: Muninn is never explained, so a first-time reader can't tell what it is or where the `github` tool lives.
It doesn't say why they return 403, for example a session permission limit. The reader can't judge whether the guard is still needed.

point: The route guard now also denies `gh api` POST calls to `/releases` and `/git/refs` paths, because these calls return 403 from a session, and the commit adds tests for the new cases.
